# 1 Clement Chapter 53 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 53 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_053_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 53

**53:1** For you know, and you know well, the sacred Scriptures, beloved, and you have looked carefully into the oracles of God. We therefore remind you of these things.

**53:2** When Moses went up the mountain and had spent forty days and forty nights in fasting and humiliation, God said to him: "Moses, Moses, come down quickly from here, for your people, whom you led out of the land of Egypt, have acted lawlessly. They have quickly turned aside from the way which you appointed for them: they have made for themselves molten images."

**53:3** And the LORD said to him: "I have spoken to you once and twice, saying, I have seen this people and behold, they are stiff-necked; allow me to destroy them, and I will blot out their name from under heaven, and I will make you into a great nation and a wonderful one, much more than this."

**53:4** And Moses said: "By no means, Lord. Forgive this people their sin, or else blot me also out of the book of the living."

**53:5** O magnificent love! O unsurpassed perfection! The servant speaking boldly to the LORD. He asks for forgiveness for the multitude, or demands that he himself be blotted out along with them.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
